title: Field values
notes: Field Value rules define allowed values separately from a property. Apply To class and ruleset context allow the same inherited property to have different permitted values. A short, static list shared by all contexts may instead live on the property. Frequently changing external data belongs in a data source rather than hundreds of field-value rules.
examples: The shared pyStatusWork property needs a custom Resolved-Returned value for Returns cases only. Add the value in the Returns class context; do not clone the standard property for every case type.
pitfalls: Property versus values
Each context-specific value requires a new property.
Keep the property reusable and vary Field Value rules by context.
Static rule versus live data
Use Field Values for a rapidly changing external inventory.
Use an appropriate data source for live records.
questions: Two case types inherit one status property but need different custom statuses. Which design supports that?
Field Value rules in the relevant class contexts
Duplicate the property name with a different type in every class
Put every status in one hard-coded portal label
Store statuses as operator passwords
Field Values separate allowed values from the property, with class context supporting specialized values.
A list is short, static and identical in all inherited classes. Which simpler option may be sufficient?
A local list on the property
A new connector for every label
A queue processor for every selection
A new case type per value
A property-local list can fit a short common static enumeration. The context-specific reuse need drives the choice of Field Values.
Which Field Value setting controls the class context in which a value is available?
Apply To
Assignment Ready
Node Type
Product archive size
Apply To determines class applicability. The other settings address scheduling, runtime resources and packaging.
A product selector needs thousands of prices updated by a remote catalog. Which source is more appropriate than Field Values?
A Data Page backed by the catalog
One Field Value for every price change
An urgency increment
A new access group for each product
Live data should be retrieved from a data source. Rule-based allowed values are better suited to stable enumerations.
Which TWO are advantages of managing allowed values as Field Values?
Reuse the underlying property
Specialize allowed values by class context
Automatically bypass validation
Replace all integration authentication
Field Values support reuse and contextual specialization. They do not remove validation or authentication.
A custom status should apply only to a specialized case, not all Work- instances. Where should its Field Value be defined?
The specialized case class
Always @baseclass
The browser's theme
A work queue's node classification
Use the narrowest appropriate class to avoid making a case-specific value broadly available through inheritance.
A team needs a versioned change to an allowed value. Which mechanism supports Field Value versioning?
Ruleset versions
Only assignment locks
Only external SQL deletes
Changing the operator's worklist
Field Values are rules and can be versioned within rulesets; they are not individual work assignments.
A developer adds a new allowed status. Which check is most useful before release?
Verify the value is offered in the intended class context and not unintentionally elsewhere
Check only that the rule has a name
Increase every deadline
Delete the inherited status property
Context-specific availability must be tested in the consuming case types. Naming alone does not validate applicability.

title: Validating data against a pattern
notes: An Edit Validate rule checks a property's character format. A Validate rule can enforce broader business conditions and call Edit Validate at submission. Built-in patterns may validate on field exit; custom Java Edit Validate logic executes server-side. A valid format does not establish that an identifier exists or belongs to the user.
examples: An internal asset tag must match three letters followed by four digits. Check its pattern with Edit Validate, then separately check uniqueness or existence using application logic. Test valid, malformed, empty and boundary inputs.
pitfalls: Pattern versus business truth
Matching a format proves an identifier is genuine.
Separate syntax checks from existence and authorization.
Timing
Every custom Edit Validate rule executes in the browser.
Distinguish supported built-in client behavior from server-side custom logic.
questions: An asset code must follow a fixed character pattern. Which rule is designed for this?
Edit Validate
A Product rule
A work group
A Split Join
Edit Validate checks property formats. Packaging and process coordination do not validate character patterns.
A code passes its pattern check. Which conclusion is still unsupported?
The code exists in the authoritative register
The characters fit the configured format
The pattern rule accepted the input
The syntax check succeeded
Format validation checks syntax, not existence in a system of record or ownership.
A form must ensure its end date follows its start date. Which mechanism fits this cross-field business condition?
Validate rule
A character pattern alone
A Field Value label
A node type
A Validate rule can express business conditions involving several fields. An Edit Validate pattern is focused on field format.
A Validate rule calls Edit Validate during submission. What does the Edit Validate still check?
The field's format, at submission time
The operator's password hash
Only ruleset dependencies
Only case urgency
Calling the format rule from broader validation changes when it runs, not its purpose.
Which TWO should be included in a custom pattern validation test?
Inputs that should be accepted
Malformed and boundary inputs that should be rejected
Only the portal logo
Only a successful connector response
Positive and negative cases establish both acceptance and rejection behavior. Unrelated UI assets do not exercise the pattern.
Why should custom Java in an Edit Validate rule be reviewed carefully?
It adds server-side code and potential security and maintenance risks
It automatically encrypts the database
It disables every rule warning
It creates an independent access group
Custom code needs review and testing. Prefer an existing suitable pattern before implementing custom logic.
A select field must restrict values to a stable approved list. Which design can enforce this before a pattern is needed?
A controlled drop-down with approved values
Allow arbitrary text and trust the label
Increase assignment urgency
Create a new ruleset per submission
A constrained choice list can prevent invalid enumeration values. Pattern checks address different input requirements.
A built-in field pattern reports an error when the user tabs out. Does that eliminate the need to validate server-side processing paths?
No; submitted and non-browser paths still need appropriate validation
Yes; all API clients necessarily run browser scripts
Yes; field color guarantees correctness
Only if the field name begins with py
Client feedback improves usability but does not establish correctness for every path. Server processing must enforce its requirements.

title: Keyed Data Pages
notes: A keyed Data Page selects embedded records from one cached list using configured keys, reducing repeated source calls for individual items. Keyed access is supported for read-only pages with thread or requestor scope. Define keys, uniqueness and refresh strategy; keyed access is not a guarantee that a stale or incomplete source list contains every current record.
examples: A requestor-scoped product list is loaded once, keyed by ProductID, and supplies details for multiple selections. Refresh the list when the business requires newer catalog data; compare connector calls before and after the change.
pitfalls: Key versus connector parameter
Every keyed lookup requires a new remote request.
Lookup uses records in the cached list subject to its load/refresh policy.
Cache versus freshness
Cached records are always current.
Configure refresh according to business requirements.
questions: A form loads a list of branches, then retrieves several branch details by ID. What can reduce repeated source calls?
Enable keyed access on the cached list Data Page
Create a new connector per branch label
Disable caching for every lookup
Make the list a Product rule
Keyed access retrieves matching embedded records from the list. It can avoid separate detail pages and repeated source exchanges.
Which TWO scopes support keyed access on a read-only Data Page?
Thread
Requestor
Node
An arbitrary scope named Global
Keyed Data Pages support read-only thread and requestor scopes. Do not assume the same keyed-access configuration supports node scope.
Which Data Page mode is supported for this keyed-access configuration?
Read-only
Editable only
Savable only
A ruleset validation mode
This feature selects records from a read-only list. Editing and saving use different data management mechanisms.
The source list changed after it was cached. Why may a keyed lookup return outdated data?
Keyed lookup does not itself guarantee a reload of the source list
Every key lookup deletes the cache
Rulesets cannot hold Data Pages
Requestor pages never load from connectors
Caching and freshness are separate requirements. Apply an appropriate refresh strategy to the source list.
Two records share the supposed unique lookup key. What should the team review?
The key design and uniqueness of the source data
Only the portal's theme
Only the case deadline
The operator's browser language
A deterministic single-record lookup needs suitable keys. Duplicate identifiers undermine that assumption.
Which measurement best checks the expected benefit of keyed access?
Source calls while selecting several records from the same loaded list
The number of case stages only
The logo dimensions
The pass score of a mock exam
The proposed improvement is fewer exchanges with the source, so measure those calls for a representative sequence.
A required record is absent from a cached filtered list. What is the safe conclusion?
The lookup list may not cover that record; review filtering and refresh
The record cannot exist in any source
Keyed access automatically creates it
It must be a locking failure
A lookup operates on available cached records. Absence from that subset is not proof of absence from the authoritative system.
A list is keyed by warehouse and item ID. Which input must the lookup provide?
Values for the configured key fields
Only the display color
Only the ruleset major version
A random operator name
Configured keys identify the relevant record. Unrelated metadata cannot select the business row.

title: Exchanging data with other applications
notes: A connector lets Pega call an external system; a service lets an external caller invoke Pega. Choose the direction first, then protocol, authentication, mapping and failure behavior. SOAP uses a WSDL contract; REST integrations use HTTP resources and operations.

A Data Type can use a local Pega system of record, transient case data, or an external source. External-source configuration creates connector and mapping assets. Parameterize requests, map response fields, use authentication profiles and vary endpoints by environment rather than copying hard-coded production URLs.
examples: A claim needs a repair estimate from a vendor: Pega calls the vendor with a connector. If the vendor creates a claim in Pega, the inbound request uses a Pega service/API.
A D_Customer page passes CustomerID to a REST service and maps the returned name and contact fields. Test Dev and Production endpoint settings and reject a mismatched response.
pitfalls: Direction
A connector exposes a Pega API to external callers.
Connectors call out; services receive calls.
Transport versus mapping
A successful HTTP call proves all fields are mapped correctly.
Assert the mapped values and error paths.
questions: Pega must call a warehouse API to obtain stock. Which integration direction applies?
Connector
Inbound Pega service
An attachment privilege
A case lock
The application is the caller of an external system, so it uses a connector.
A supplier must create a case in Pega from its own application. Which direction applies?
A Pega service/API receiving the request
A connector used only for outbound requests
A ruleset skim
A local Field Value
An external client invokes Pega through an inbound service/API. An outbound connector serves the opposite direction.
A legacy SOAP endpoint describes its operations and messages. Which artifact provides that contract?
WSDL
An assignment SLA
A work group list
A theme token file
WSDL describes the SOAP service interface and is used when configuring operations and mappings.
Which TWO belong in an integration design before declaring it ready?
Authentication requirements
Request/response mappings and failure behavior
Only the source system's logo
A guarantee that timeouts cannot occur
A reachable endpoint is not enough. Authentication, correct mappings and explicit error handling make the integration usable.
A customer ID changes between calls. How should a reusable data source identify the requested customer?
Pass the customer ID as a request parameter
Create a new connector rule for every customer
Use the case urgency as the ID
Hard-code the first customer's ID
Parameterization supports reuse while selecting the correct source record.
A data object exists only while a case is processed and is not pushed to a system of record. Which source classification fits?
No system of record
External system of record by definition
A ruleset's access role
A SOAP operation regardless of use
Not all application data is persisted to a system of record. Transient processing data can use this source classification.
The same integration is moved from QA to Production. Which configuration prevents calls to the QA endpoint?
Environment-specific endpoint settings
Only a new portal label
An increased SLA deadline
Changing the question count
External resource addresses can differ by environment. Configuration must select the target environment's endpoint.
A REST call returns HTTP success but the customer name is empty in Pega. What should be examined?
Response mapping and actual payload structure
Only the work queue manager
Only assignment urgency
The product archive extension
Successful transport does not establish correct field mapping. Inspect the payload, nesting and mapping rules.

title: Integration errors
notes: Distinguish transient failures from persistent configuration or request errors. Temporary unavailability can justify a controlled retry; malformed requests or invalid configuration need correction. Communicate failure early rather than silently returning misleading success.

For Data Page connector loads, inspect errors in the response Data Transform and invoke reusable handling such as a copy of pxErrorHandlingTemplate. The connector error-handler flow covers errors not handled earlier; the default ConnectionProblem flow is not automatically invoked after a response transform has already handled the error.

Test success, incorrect data, timeout and authentication failures. Assert mappings on Data Pages and use appropriate credentials, certificates, keystores and approved endpoints. Secure transport does not make all incoming data safe; validate inputs and avoid exposing credentials in logs.
examples: A partner is restarting: notify the user and retry when appropriate. A wrong SOAP message schema keeps failing until its mapping is fixed, so repeated blind retries waste resources.
D_Policy detects page messages in its response transform, writes a safe diagnostic record and returns a user-actionable message. A fallback flow is reserved for unhandled failures.
Run D_Address with synthetic valid and invalid IDs, then assert mapped fields and failure messages. Configure required certificates in a keystore and keep secrets out of test fixtures.
pitfalls: Retry everything
A malformed request is fixed by indefinite retry.
Correct persistent configuration errors; retry transient failures deliberately.
Double handling
The error flow must run even when the response transform handled the error.
Choose the handling path appropriate to where the failure was detected.
questions: A partner API is briefly unavailable during restart. Which response is most appropriate?
A controlled retry and a clear failure message when needed
Report fabricated successful data
Delete all application rules
Keep retrying indefinitely without limits
Temporary unavailability can recover. Retry must remain controlled and the user must understand the failure rather than receive false success.
Every call fails because the SOAP request has the wrong schema. What is the priority?
Correct the request mapping and investigate the persistent error
Retry forever without changing the request
Increase case urgency
Hide all error messages
A malformed request is a persistent configuration error. Repeating the same request will not repair it.
Where should a Data Page connector response be checked for early load errors?
Response Data Transform
Only a portal theme rule
Only the case status label
Only the product export wizard
Response transforms are a suitable point to inspect Data Page errors and delegate reusable handling.
Which standard template can be copied for reusable Data Page error handling?
pxErrorHandlingTemplate
pyStatusWork
pxUrgencyWorkClass
SplitForEach
pxErrorHandlingTemplate provides an error-handling Data Transform pattern. The other names refer to unrelated properties or flow behavior.
A response Data Transform already detects and handles a connector error. What should not be assumed?
That the connector error-handler flow also runs automatically
That the transform can display an error
That failure behavior should be tested
That the user may need an alternative path
The fallback error flow covers failures not addressed by another mechanism. Earlier handling does not imply both paths execute.
Which TWO cases belong in integration testing?
Successful responses with assertions on mapped fields
Timeout and authentication failure paths
Only the response logo
Only a ruleset label with no call
Mapping assertions validate data correctness; negative paths validate behavior when communication or authentication fails.
An HTTPS service requires a client certificate and private key. Which Pega resource holds these materials?
Keystore
A work queue
An assignment goal
A field-value display label
Keystores hold security certificates and keys used for authenticated secure communication.
A trusted endpoint returns text that is later rendered or queried. Which design remains necessary?
Validate and safely handle incoming data
Treat all returned text as executable code
Disable server-side checks
Write all credentials into user-visible messages
Trusted transport does not establish that every payload is safe for every sink. Input validation and safe handling remain required.
